name: Popconfirm
summary: A lightweight inline confirmation popover anchored to the trigger — confirm/cancel a low-risk action.
lead: Popconfirm carries a positioned popover, a focus trap and two action buttons — too much to rebuild as a web component, so it stays on real Ant: antd v6 (React) and ant-design-vue v4 (Vue), both themed once by the shared popconfirmTheme. Two implementations, one DS V3 look. This is the composite half of the hybrid.

spec.label: Anchor
spec.value: pops from the trigger; not a full modal

props.name: onConfirm
props.desc: Fires when the confirm button is clicked

whenToUse.when: a low-risk, reversible action needs a quick inline check (delete a row, discard a draft)
a destructive or irreversible action needs a deliberate, focused confirmation
the action is trivial and easily undone — prefer an undo toast

opinion.note: Reserve Popconfirm for low-risk, reversible actions — anchor it to the trigger and keep the question to one line. A destructive or irreversible action (delete account, publish) needs a Modal (see the overlays pattern), never a popover.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3 has no measured Popconfirm cell; the composite maps DS tokens (primary confirm, radius-8 popover, #E3E3E3 cancel border) onto antd's Popconfirm via the shared popconfirmTheme. A deliberate, documented extension.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: Composite has no framework-free element, so its paste-and-run form is a CDN-React page — React + antd load from a CDN and mount on open, consuming the SAME shared popconfirmTheme. No build step.

codeNote: React and Vue are two real vendor libraries at two Ant generations — they can't share a primitive. They converge via the same token/theme (popconfirmTheme); residual drift is caught by visual regression.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Composite shown as a CDN-React page mounted at #react-root; the Popconfirm is open, its popover portalled to <body>, so the real antd v6 popover surface + confirm/cancel buttons bound to popconfirmTheme are measurable at document level. Selectors match antd v6: the surface is .ant-popover-container; the action buttons are scoped to .ant-popconfirm-buttons so the danger TRIGGER button is not measured by mistake.
